title: Report: Ravens G Vega Ioane has an MCL sprain

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Report: Ravens G Vega Ioane has an MCL sprain
sources.description: Ravens rookie guard Vega Ioane had to leave Sunday's loss to the Bengals with a knee injury and a report on Tuesday suggests he'll miss some more time before returning to action.
